summary_markdown:
The conversation focused heavily on financial projections, resource allocation, and pricing models. Multiple figures were presented regarding potential revenue streams (e.g., $1.7 million USD this year; $720,000 USD a year from 40 companies). Pricing structures discussed included recurring fees ($1,700 USD per month for extended services) and hourly rates. Specific service components analyzed included 'Report feature' (estimated at 40 hours/month or $5,000 USD annually) and general project work.

Key metrics reviewed were ROI timelines (e.g., 16 months), resource capacity (hours needed vs. available), and percentage growth estimates (30-40%).
decisions: No concrete decisions were finalized during the session.
